title: Malicious code in @fadeldev/libsignal-node (npm)
description: The npm package @fadeldev/libsignal-node contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise potentially grants full control to an outside entity. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but it may not fully eliminate the malicious presence. All secrets and keys on the affected system should be rotated from a different, uncompromised device.
